description: Cancels every open order of the user, optionally only those on one event or one market. Orders caught mid-fill are skipped and returned in `processing_order_ids`; try those again shortly with cancel_order. To cancel everything on the account, pass `cancel_everything: true` and no event or market; only do that when the user asked for it.

cancel_everything.description: Must be true when neither `event` nor `market` is given, to confirm that every open order on the account should be cancelled.

event.description: Only cancel orders on this event id.

market.description: Only cancel orders on this market (outcome) id.

name: cancel_all_orders
title: Cancel all open orders
